memory_decision.limitation: Based on frozen workload memory peaks and retained graph-pool slack; candidates still require runtime validation.

caveats: All formal attempt wall time is retained, including invalid ID output.
Zero observed preemptions is not a guarantee for longer inputs or outputs.
Median TPS/TTFT/TPOT/E2E uses complete rounds only; primary items/min includes all attempts.
Natural output lengths vary; gains are not pure kernel-speed estimates.
Three complete rounds do not establish statistical significance.
Initial C3/C4 and admission rounds were interleaved; capacity and chunk arms followed sequentially.
The early N3 release used max_output_tokens=16384; this experiment uses24576. Cross-report numbers are not a pure ablation.
Checkpoint fingerprints are inherited, not freshly recomputed across all weights for this experiment.
